newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DANE SEA LINES SAYS H1 PROFIT UP 14PCT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DANE SEA LINES SAYS H1 PROFIT UP 14PCT.

text.p: Greece's DANE Sea lines posted pretax profits of 308 million drachmas in the first-half of 1996, up 14 percent from 270 million drachmas in the same period last year, it said in a statement.
DANE's turvover stabilised at 2.6 billion drachmas in the first six months of 1996, it said.

Revenues in the first eight months of the year stood at 3.944 billion drachmas, down from 3.959 billion in the same period last year on falling passenger traffic, down 2.5 percent and rising car traffic, up 9.6 percent, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
